newsitem.title: GERMANY: German traders may pick up MG lead, zinc clients.
newsitem.headline: German traders may pick up MG lead, zinc clients.

text.p: German metals traders believe they may take on some of Metallgesellschaft's lead and zinc customers after the MG trading company on Wednesday announced plans to concentrate its physical trading outside Germany.
Metallgesellschaft Handel & Beteiligungen AG (MG Handel), trading arm of the MG group said it would move metals trading to London and New York, under the control of MG Metal & Commodity Group.
The operations were previously incorporated in Frankfurt-based MG Metal & Commodity (MG MC) GmbH.
"Aluminium and copper were already mostly done from London but existing local lead and zinc customers may not necessarily follow MG staff to London," one said.
"Any switches will mostly be made by conservative small and medium sized companies which prefer to do business in Germany."
Traders said the move did not come as a great surprise because a strategically important MG base metals warehouse in Dormagen in western Germany had been closed last year.
They also said they were not entirely positive about the departure of a once leading operator.
"We may profit from the move but we need strong competition and nobody wants to be the only shop in town and bear all the risks of the price-finding process," one said.
